value.body: Compliance executives make sure an organisation meets the laws and rules that apply to it, such as company law, labour laws, data protection or sector regulations. Banks, NBFCs, listed companies, manufacturers and compliance service firms hire them. A day involves tracking deadlines, preparing filings and records, and checking new circulars.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: LLB, B.Com or a CS course

items.label: Active companies
items.note: Of ~28.1 lakh registered companies, as on 31 January 2025
items.source: Ministry of Corporate Affairs data (as reported)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers join compliance or legal teams in companies, banks or compliance firms, often as trainees. Knowing how to read a statute or circular and turn it into a checklist is the core skill employers look for.

value.title: At a glance
items: Regulated sectors such as banking have the most structured compliance teams.
Next steps: compliance officer, legal manager, or risk roles.
A Company Secretary qualification widens corporate compliance options.
